description: Crew events which must change nothing (eu07/maszyna#510): the run of eu07_td_timetable, with a coach standing on track 2, and crew events set off at the start and again at 10:36, on the run: a second driver for the locomotive (it has one), a driver for the coach (no cab), a cab which is none of 1, -1, 0, a driver taken off the coach (it has none) and a vehicle the scenery lacks. Each is refused in the log and the train runs its timetable to the stop at Przystanek.

trainsets: node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_coach dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 0 0 enddynamic
crew: event autotest_crew_second putvalues 0 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}} 1 0 endevent
event autotest_crew_coach putvalues 0 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}}_coach 1 0 endevent
event autotest_crew_cab putvalues 0 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}} 2 0 endevent
event autotest_crew_nobody putvalues 0 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}}_coach 0 0 endevent
event autotest_crew_unknown putvalues 0 none 0 0 0 Crew:autotest_no_such_vehicle 0 0 endevent
event autotest_crew_all multiple 0 none autotest_crew_second autotest_crew_coach autotest_crew_cab autotest_crew_nobody autotest_crew_unknown endevent
node -1 0 autotest_crew_launcher1 eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1034 autotest_crew_all end
node -1 0 autotest_crew_launcher2 eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1036 autotest_crew_all end

checks.pattern: Crew: \[autotest_eu07_td_crew_refused\] refused, the vehicle has a driver already
Crew: \[autotest_eu07_td_crew_refused_coach\] refused, the vehicle has no cab
Crew: \[autotest_eu07_td_crew_refused\] refused, the cab has to be 1, -1 or 0
Crew: \[autotest_eu07_td_crew_refused_coach\] no driver to take off
